series = Series("value", [0.0])
chart = BarChart(["v1"], [series], "grouped", "Example", "Value")
quality = Callout("info", "Training signal", "The cleaner kept the most useful columns, dropped 8 lower-ranked columns, and removed 2 identifier columns before creating this OpenUI target.")
followups = FollowUpBlock([f1, f2, f3])

f3 = FollowUpItem("Summarize another resource")
